## 🎯 Type of Change
*Please mark relevant items with an [x]*

- [ ] 🐛 **Bug Fix**: Non-breaking fix for an unresolved bug or issue
- [ ] ✨ **New Feature**: Non-breaking feature addition or functional enhancement
- [ ] 💥 **Breaking Change**: Fix or feature that alters existing contracts or interfaces
- [ ] 📝 **Documentation**: Updates to Readmes, API docs, code comments, or architectural docs
- [ ] 🎨 **UI / Styling**: Responsive layout adjustments, CSS refinements, or theme updates
- [ ] ⚡ **Performance**: Latency reduction, bundle optimization, or resource caching
- [ ] ♻️ **Refactoring**: Code restructure without behavioral alterations
- [ ] 🧪 **Testing & CI**: Unit/integration tests, GitHub Actions, or devtooling

## 🧪 Testing Verification
*Describe the tests and verification steps performed to ensure code stability.*

### Manual Verification
- [ ] Local frontend server builds and runs cleanly (`npm run dev`)
- [ ] Local backend API routes respond as expected
- [ ] Cross-browser validation (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)
- [ ] Mobile and desktop viewport responsiveness verified
- [ ] Browser console has zero errors and zero unhandled warnings

### Automated Verification
- [ ] Linters executed without errors (`npm run lint` / formatters)
- [ ] Production build succeeds without errors (`npm run build`)
